headline: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire
summary: The tech mogul reached the historic milestone on June 12 following a record surge in the value of SpaceX shares.
details: Elon Musk has made history by becoming the first person in the world to reach a net worth of one trillion dollars.
The milestone was achieved on June 12, driven by a record-breaking increase in the share price of his space exploration company, SpaceX.
Musk now stands as the sole member of the 'trillionaire club,' surpassing all other global billionaires in wealth.

headline: Dhaka's Ad-Din Hospital license cancelled as admissions stop
summary: The Health Minister announced the cancellation of the hospital's license, citing concerns over financial dealings and operations.
details: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has cancelled the license of Ad-Din Hospital in Dhaka, leading to a complete stop in new patient admissions.
caption:
Ad-Din Hospital's license has been cancelled, and new patient admissions have stopped.

The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has cancelled the license of Ad-Din Hospital in Dhaka, leading to a complete stop in new patient admissions.
